{{Top|leg}}
'''Mothma Squadron''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] that was assigned to the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] warship [[Bounty (warship)|''Bounty'']] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. Equipped with [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighters]], it participated in Alliance operations monitoring [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] fleet movements in the [[Both system|Bothawui system]].
